name: Drive-by Compromise
description: User compromised simply by visiting a malicious or booby-trapped website.

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Internet-facing software or interface exploited for initial access.

name: Exploitation of Remote Services
description: Software vulnerability exploited to abuse a remote service for access or movement.

name: External Remote Services
description: VPN, Citrix, or similar remote access gateways used as an entry point.

name: Internet Accessible Device
description: Device unintentionally exposed directly to the internet without protections.

name: Remote Services
description: RDP, SSH, SMB or similar used to move between OT assets and segments.

name: Replication Through Removable Media
description: Malware carried into an air-gapped environment via USB or removable media.

name: Rogue Master
description: Adversary stands up a fake master/controller to send legitimate-looking commands.

name: Spearphishing Attachment
description: Malicious file attached to a targeted email to gain initial execution.

name: Supply Chain Compromise
description: Products, software, or delivery mechanisms tampered with before reaching the target.

name: Transient Cyber Asset
description: Temporary vendor/contractor laptops or devices brought into the OT environment.

name: Wireless Compromise
description: Unauthorized access gained via a compromised wireless device or network.

name: Autorun Image
description: AutoRun/AutoPlay abused to execute malicious code from removable media.

name: Change Operating Mode
description: Controller operating mode switched to enable unauthorized programming access.

name: Command-Line Interface
description: CLI used to interact with and execute commands on a system.

name: Execution through API
description: Control-system APIs called directly to trigger device-level functions.

name: Graphical User Interface
description: GUI access used instead of CLI to enhance interactive execution.

name: Hooking
description: API calls intercepted and redirected for execution or privilege escalation.

name: Modify Controller Tasking
description: Controller task scheduling altered to run adversary-supplied logic.

name: Native API
description: OS-level APIs called directly to access low-level system functions.

name: Scripting
description: Scripting languages used to execute arbitrary adversary-supplied code.

name: User Execution
description: Victim interaction (open, click, grant permission) triggers malicious execution.

name: Insecure Credentials
description: Default or hardcoded vendor credentials left unchanged on devices.

name: Modify Firmware
description: Malicious or vulnerable firmware installed on a system or module.

name: Modify Program
description: Controller program altered to change interaction with the physical process.

name: Project File Infection
description: Engineering project files infected to propagate malicious logic to PLCs.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Stolen legitimate credentials used to bypass access controls.

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
description: Software vulnerability exploited to run code with elevated permissions.

name: Exploitation for Evasion
description: Vulnerability exploited specifically to disable or bypass security controls.

name: Indicator Removal on Host
description: Logs, files, or artifacts altered or deleted to cover tracks.

name: Masquerading
description: Malicious files disguised as legitimate vendor executables or configs.

name: Rootkit
description: Rootkit hides programs, files, services, or connections from detection.

name: System Binary Proxy Execution
description: Trusted signed binaries abused to proxy execution of malicious content.

name: Unauthorized Message
description: Spoofed command or reporting messages injected to evade or manipulate.

name: Network Connection Enumeration
description: Device communication patterns mapped to understand network roles.

name: Network Sniffing
description: Network interface used to passively capture traffic and reconnaissance data.

name: Remote System Discovery
description: Hosts on the network enumerated by IP, hostname, or identifier.

name: Remote System Information Discovery
description: Make, model, role, and configuration of remote systems gathered.

name: Wireless Sniffing
description: RF communications captured for remote control and reporting protocols.

name: Lateral Tool Transfer
description: Tools or files copied between internal systems to support movement.

name: Program Download
description: A user program transferred to a controller, overwriting logic.

name: Adversary-in-the-Middle
description: Network traffic intercepted and modified in real time (e.g. ARP poisoning).

name: Automated Collection
description: Scripts or tools used to automatically harvest ICS environment data.

name: Data from Information Repositories
description: Design documents, schematics, or process data pulled from repositories.

name: Data from Local System
description: Local files, configs, or databases targeted and collected.

name: Detect Operating Mode
description: Current PLC operating mode gathered to assess reprogramming feasibility.

name: I/O Image
description: PLC input/output image table values captured for process insight.

name: Monitor Process State
description: Physical process state information gathered via OPC tags, historian, or network.

name: Point & Tag Identification
description: Process points and tags collected to understand environment layout.

name: Program Upload
description: Existing PLC program uploaded to study the underlying control logic.

name: Screen Capture
description: Screenshots taken of HMI or workstation displays to study operations.

name: Commonly Used Port
description: Common ports used for C2 to blend in with normal traffic.

name: Connection Proxy
description: Proxy used as an intermediary to direct and disguise C2 traffic.

name: Standard Application Layer Protocol
description: Protocols like HTTP, OPC, DNP3 or Modbus abused for C2 channels.

name: Activate Firmware Update Mode
description: Update mode forced on a device to halt its normal response functions.

name: Alarm Suppression
description: Protection function alarms targeted to prevent operator notification.

name: Block Communications
description: Serial, Ethernet, or Wi-Fi comms blocked to disrupt reporting/command paths.

name: Block Operational Technology Message
description: Command or reporting messages blocked from reaching their target.

name: Change Credential
description: Device credentials modified to lock out operators and responders.

name: Data Destruction
description: Files or data destroyed, often to cover tracks or disrupt recovery.

name: Denial of Service
description: Device overwhelmed or crashed, rendering it unresponsive to events.

name: Device Restart/Shutdown
description: Device forcibly restarted or shut down to disrupt physical processes.

name: Manipulate I/O Image
description: PLC I/O image table overridden via direct memory manipulation.

name: Modify Alarm Settings
description: Alarm thresholds or settings changed to prevent expected notifications.

name: Service Stop
description: Critical services disabled to prevent incident response or recovery.

name: Brute Force I/O
description: I/O point values repeatedly changed to destabilize a process function.

name: Modify Parameter
description: Device parameters altered to change how and when actions execute.

name: Damage to Property
description: Physical damage caused to infrastructure, equipment, or the environment.

name: Denial of Control
description: Operators and engineers temporarily prevented from interacting with controls.

name: Denial of View
description: Operator oversight disrupted by interrupting the HMI/control interface.

name: Loss of Availability
description: Essential components disrupted, preventing delivery of products or services.

name: Loss of Control
description: Sustained loss of control achieved; operators cannot issue commands.

name: Loss of Productivity and Revenue
description: Availability and integrity disruption resulting in operational/financial loss.

name: Loss of Protection
description: Protective system functions compromised, risking equipment or personnel.

name: Loss of Safety
description: Safety system functions compromised, allowing unsafe process conditions.

name: Loss of View
description: Sustained loss of visibility requiring local, hands-on operator intervention.

name: Manipulation of Control
description: Physical process control manipulated via setpoint or parameter changes.

name: Manipulation of View
description: Information reported to operators falsified while the real process diverges.

name: Theft of Operational Information
description: Design documents, schedules, or operational data stolen for gain.
